evidence.command: Independent read-only review of current Apple, Bun, Homebrew, and Git primary documentation
facts: Apple Command Line Tools installation requires a user-confirmed system dialog.
bunx can execute an exact version of a published package.
bun ci is the frozen-lockfile installation path.
Homebrew currently does not provide the repository-pinned Bun 1.3.6 release.
Git can initialize only the recorded mesh submodule path without following a floating remote branch.
Immutable commit IDs provide reproducibility and signed tags or commits add publisher authenticity.

residual_risks: The chosen bootstrap still requires Bun, Git, network access, and existing repository authentication.
Queen and mesh revisions must be published before the installer can complete.
